description: This plot illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three different values. The x-axis is labeled “Question Popularity” and is a linear scale ranging from 15 to 55, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Values” and is a linear scale ranging from 0.88 to 1.00, with tick labels at intervals of 0.02. A blue line, marked with circular data points and labeled “Accuracy”, begins at approximately 0.92 at a question popularity of 15, increases to approximately 0.98 at a question popularity of 40, and remains at approximately 0.98 through a question popularity of 55. A green line, marked with triangular data points and labeled “Confidence”, begins at approximately 0.98 at a question popularity of 15, fluctuates between approximately 0.98 and 0.99 through a question popularity of 40, and ends at approximately 0.99 at a question popularity of 55. A red line, marked with square data points and labeled “Alignment”, begins at approximately 0.92 at a question popularity of 15, decreases to approximately 0.88 at a question popularity of 20, then increases to approximately 0.98 at a question popularity of 40, and remains at approximately 0.98 through a question popularity of 55.
